{{Top|leg}}
The '''Level 2012 Physical Plant''' was a physical plant on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]], and [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]] chased several [[underdweller]]s through it in an effort to retrieve a stolen [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. The building was filled with [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and machinery, and its interior was seldom seen by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. The building had a self-contained plumbing system.
